label: GitHub Copilot
description: Branch `copilot`, for Copilot CLI and VS Code agent plugins. Copilot reads the Claude layout (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/, agents/, commands/), so the conversion is small: the plugin root becomes a placeholder the preamble explains (Copilot documents ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} for hooks and MCP config only), the ask tool is renamed, and the manifest names its agents/commands folders explicitly. awesome-copilot pins a tag + sha, hence `tag`.

transforms.text: > **AgenTeX on {host}.** `<agentex-root>` stands for this plugin's install folder: `{root}` from the folder this file is in. Resolve it to an absolute path before you run or read anything that uses it. When a step says to dispatch a bundled agent (`qa-executor`, `api-executor`, `mobile-qa-executor`), start it as a subagent.

forbiddenText.why: Copilot does not expand it in skill text
